title: ServiceNow ↔ Microsoft Intune Integration — Device Inventory & CMDB Sync
author_notes: pricing: T3/T4 — two-platform integration (ServiceNow + Intune/Graph) + CMDB mapping. Commercial anchor $2,795 sits at the top of the T3 Advanced band (multi-component, 2-3 technologies, conditional logic across ServiceNow IRE + Microsoft Graph). Nonprofit round(2795*0.60,2)=1677.00; Government round(2795*0.85,2)=2375.75.

gov decision: gov_variant=false. The ServiceNow Service Graph Connector app and CMDB model are the SAME for Government; only the Microsoft endpoints change (graph.microsoft.us / dod-graph.microsoft.us, login.microsoftonline.us, intune.microsoft.us) and the scripts are cloud-aware via Connect-MgGraph -Environment USGov|USGovDoD. Differences documented INLINE in 02/03/06/07; no separate source-gov deliverable warranted. Flagged 'verify for GCC High' whether the Store connector release exposes a configurable sovereign Graph endpoint (custom Integration Hub import is the fallback).

VERIFIED FACTS (with sources): (1) ServiceNow ingests Intune managed-device data via the 'Service Graph Connector for Microsoft Intune' (ServiceNow Store), requiring an ITOM Visibility or ITOM Discovery subscription; writes to CMDB via IRE. Sources: ServiceNow Store https://store.servicenow.com/store/app/daa9ef221b246a50a85b16db234bcb6d ; ServiceNow docs https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/xanadu-servicenow-platform/page/product/configuration-management/concept/cmdb-integration-intune.html ; ServiceNow community troubleshooting blog https://www.servicenow.com/community/cmdb-blog/service-graph-connector-for-microsoft-intune-troubleshooting/ba-p/2275201 . (2) Connector authenticates to Microsoft Graph (OAuth2 client-credentials) with APPLICATION permissions: DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All, DeviceManagementApps.Read.All, DeviceManagementServiceConfig.Read.All, Directory.Read.All (all read-only, admin-consented) — per the ServiceNow community troubleshooting blog; scope names + semantics verified against Microsoft Learn https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/developer/configure-graph-api-access (DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All = read Managed Device / Device Category / Detected App / Malware info; all Intune scopes require admin access). (3) Data streams: managed devices /deviceManagement/managedDevices, detected apps /deviceManagement/detectedApps; CMDB target = computer class cmdb_ci_computer + a handheld/mobile class (community references cmdb_ci_handheld_computing / a mobiledevices stream). (4) Workspace ONE parallel: 'Service Graph Connector for VMware Workspace ONE UEM' — same Service Graph framework, same ITOM requirement, same CMDB classes — so Intune reconciles onto existing WS1 CIs via serial-number IRE. Source: ServiceNow docs cmdb-integration-workspace-one + VMware/Omnissa integration docs.

COULD NOT FULLY VERIFY (flagged inline as 'verify against current ServiceNow documentation'): exact release-specific CMDB handheld/mobile class name (cmdb_ci_handheld_computing likely but not confirmed on the official docs render), the exact detected-apps CMDB target table (software model), the exact connector data-stream display names, and exact ServiceNow role names — the official docs.servicenow.com Intune connector page did not render usable detail via fetch; relied on ServiceNow community blogs + Store.
